question: What condition is attributed to even a wise person when acting at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice?
premises: Action is specified at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
Even a wise person is the subject.
That person is described as burning.
inference: Even a wise person, acting at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice, is in a burning condition.
uncertainties: Causal relation between the means and dahyamāna remains open
plain_english: Even a wise person, burning, acts at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
